c74object.name: jit.void.sm.reader
c74object.description:
jit.void.sm.reader reads numeric data from a POSIX shared memory segment following the VOID Shared Memory contract (version 2) and outputs it as a Jitter matrix.
The object operates in strict snapshot mode. On each outputmatrix call, the shared memory segment is opened, validated, read once, and immediately closed.
The shared memory layout starts with a fixed header containing identity, versioning, topology, epoch, frame counter, and ownership information. This header is followed by a contiguous array of 32-bit floating point values organized as channels by length.
The output matrix dimensions are set automatically to match the shared memory layout. Rows correspond to channels and columns correspond to samples.
This object is designed for robust and deterministic inter-process communication and is symmetric with jit.void.sm.writer.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description:
Name of the POSIX shared memory segment to attach to.
This must match the name used by the corresponding writer.

inlet.description:
This object has no matrix or message inlets.
Data is produced on demand when outputmatrix is called.

outlet.description:
Outputs a matrix containing the numeric data read from shared memory.
The matrix is float32, single-plane, with dimensions: width = length, height = channels.

Outputs status and informational messages.
The connected message indicates that a valid shared memory snapshot was successfully read.
The disconnected message indicates that the shared memory segment could not be opened or failed validation.
The writerinfo message outputs ownership information stored in the shared memory header.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description:
Name of the shared memory segment to attach to.
Changing this attribute closes any existing mapping. The next outputmatrix call will attempt to open the new segment if the reader is enabled.

attribute.name: connect
attribute.description:
Enables or disables the shared memory reader.
When enabled, a snapshot read is attempted on each outputmatrix call.
When disabled, no shared memory access occurs and the output matrix remains empty.

message.name: getWriterInfo
message.description:
Outputs ownership information stored in the shared memory header via the dumpout outlet.
The message format is: writerinfo app project node
